guides.title: A website that feels like your business
guides.excerpt: Clear words, thoughtful design and a simple next step. Start with the essentials that matter to your customers.
paragraphs: Start with the questions your customers bring to your website: what do you offer, who is it for, and how can they get in touch? Give each answer a clear place on the page. A short, descriptive heading is a useful starting point.

Choose photographs and words that reflect your business. Then try the page on your phone: can you find the service you need and reach the contact details without hunting? Keep the next step easy to see, whether that is an enquiry, a booking or a visit.

image.alt: Laura Faichney’s colourful homepage shown on a laptop

guides.title: Help local customers find you
guides.excerpt: A practical starting point for keeping your business information clear and consistent online.
paragraphs: Keep the basics accurate: your business name, contact details, opening hours and the services you provide. Check these details on your website and, if your business is eligible, in your Google Business Profile.

Google explains that local results depend on relevance, distance and prominence. Complete, accurate information helps Google understand your business, but it does not guarantee a particular ranking. Start with useful descriptions and genuine photographs rather than promises of an instant first-place result.

guides.title: Keep your website feeling fresh
guides.excerpt: Small, regular checks can keep the information your customers rely on useful and up to date.
paragraphs: Make a short list of the pages your customers use most. Review opening hours, services and contact information when something changes. Remove details that are no longer accurate and check that links still lead to the right place.

Write for the person reading the page. Use clear headings, answer practical questions and add information when it is helpful. Updating the date alone is not a substitute for improving the content: Google’s guidance encourages useful, reliable information created for people.
